DataObject.description:
One data-plane object ``prove`` may read, bound to the resource that holds it.

A data-plane call is allowed only if its operation is listed under ``prove`` *and*
its (resource, path) pair is listed here, so a scope cannot read the payroll blob
path from the invoices account, or a secret from another vault.

resource.description: The vault or storage account (full ARM ID).
resource.title: Resource

DataObject.title: DataObject

ScopeBudget.description: Per-run limits enforced by the gate.
ScopeBudget.title: ScopeBudget

StrikeEscalation.description:
S4 (approved 2026-11-27): the one identity other than a test identity a strike
may act as, and the one thing it may do.

Absent means no token request and no write as anyone but a test identity. The
gate allows the escalated identity only to assign this marker role to a test
identity on its own service principal, and to remove that assignment.

marker_role_id.description:
The marker app role Terraform defines on that service principal's application
(``lab/identities.tf``); the gate checks it live before S4 may assign it.
marker_role_id.title: Marker Role Id

service_principal.description:
The escalation target's service principal (``app-escalation-target``). It must
be a ``graph-service-principal`` strike target, and never a test identity.
service_principal.title: Service Principal

StrikeEscalation.title: StrikeEscalation

StrikeScope.description: The ``strike:`` block: which lab objects strikes may write, and until when.

expires_at.description: Strike writes stop at this instant, even if the manifest is still valid.
expires_at.title: Expires At

StrikeScope.title: StrikeScope

StrikeTarget.description:
One object ``strike`` may write to (M4 strike plan, "Lab objects only").

Rendered by Terraform from the lab's own resources, never hand-written. A Graph
target also has to pass a live check (its lab tags and display name) before the
gate allows the first write to it.

application.description: Service principals: the object ID of its application, also a target.
application.title: Application

display_name.description:
Graph targets: the display name Terraform gave the object; the live check
compares it.
display_name.title: Display Name

id.description: A full ARM ID (``arm``: a vault or a storage account) or an Entra object ID.
id.title: Id

StrikeTarget.title: StrikeTarget

TestIdentity.description: An identity the executor may act as (``strike``).

app_id.description:
Application (client) ID. When set, ``fns prove --live`` also requires the
token's ``appid`` to match it (decision V4).
app_id.title: App Id

object_id.description: Entra object ID of the service principal or managed identity.
object_id.title: Object Id

TestIdentity.title: TestIdentity

allowed_operations.description: Exact operations per verb. A missing verb allows nothing.
allowed_operations.title: Allowed Operations

data_objects.description: Data-plane objects ``prove`` may read. Empty means no data-plane call at all.
data_objects.title: Data Objects

expires_at.description: After this instant the manifest allows nothing.
expires_at.title: Expires At

strike.description: Lab objects ``strike`` may write to (M4). Absent means no write at all.

tenant_id.description: The only tenant any call may target. The signed-in tenant must match.
tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
